versions.localizedDescription: The unread badge no longer lags the banner: counts are only set by the newest read, a failed read no longer empties every badge, overlapping sweeps are joined, and a reply puts a floor of one under the count the instant the banner appears.

The unread count is back on every bot's face (and the breathing beacon at the row's edge) on both phone and Mac — the roster restyle had replaced both with one static dot. A reply in another chat raises a banner again while the app is open, and read marks are written from the host's clock so a fast phone clock can no longer silence a bot.

Memory and Soul on the bot's own page, and Bot Settings now owns the identity verbs together (Bot icon, Soul, Memory) instead of hiding two of them behind a long press. Memory shows the two documents the bot carries into every turn, read-only, with their sizes. A Library document can now leave the app: share it on the phone (long press, swipe, or the open document's toolbar) or Save a copy on the Mac.

The bot list's top edge: the CHATS label is gone, the list sits closer to the bar's buttons, and content fades under the bar instead of meeting it with a hard seam. Search conversations now opens as a glass pill instead of bare text on the transcript.

Routines: what a bot runs on its own, with a real pause/resume switch beside each one (read from the host's scheduler, with the error text when a run failed). Three rows on the bot page say what they open: Workspace is now Library, MCP servers is MCP, and Search is Search conversations. Both platforms.
